Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1293295 (Ubiquitin carboxyl-terminal hydrolase 14). Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by target CHEMBL ID, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and non-null pChEMBL value. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to first 1000 rows. Keep all activity rows without deduplication.
